mechanism: Sodium valproate may inhibit primaquine metabolism and increase risk of hemolytic anemia, particularly in G6PD-deficient patients, while primaquine may displace valproate from protein binding.
action: Monitor for signs of hemolytic anemia (jaundice, dark urine, fatigue); ensure G6PD status is known before primaquine use; consider alternative antimalarials if possible; monitor valproate levels.
